summary: Independent verification of Iter 61 Twelve Data integration. All 11 backend test cases pass: TD status/quote/candles, unmappable symbol path, backtest data_source surfacing for EURUSD M1 (twelvedata) and EURUSD_OTC 5s (local_pool), 12-call rate-limit stress (no 500s), and regressions for /api/iq720/outcome-stats, /api/ml/tournament/status, /api/signals/force-generate-v2, /api/backtest/comprehensive.

minor.issue: Under rapid back-to-back requests (12 in a row), about half of calls returned success:false with error='no_data' (upstream returned empty payload) rather than the strict 'rate_limit_local_timeout' / 'rate_limit_429' strings mentioned in the review spec. No 500s, behavior is graceful — but error taxonomy is slightly different from spec.

Local rate limiter (_acquire_rate_token, capacity=8/60s) waits up to 30s before returning rate_limit_local_timeout. With requests timeout <30s the client times out. Consider lowering server-side max_wait_s to e.g. 10s and returning a 429 immediately so clients can react faster.

When given a minimal payload it can return results=[] without erroring, hiding the absence of a data_source field. Consider returning 200 with a clear 'no_data' marker if no strategies produced results.

action_items: Consider unifying the TD error taxonomy: on rapid bursts the upstream sometimes returns empty payload which currently surfaces as 'no_data' rather than 'rate_limit_429' — clients can't differentiate transient rate-limit from genuine missing symbol.
Reduce server-side rate-limit max_wait_s from 30s to ~8-10s and return HTTP 429 immediately so callers don't have to set 30s+ timeouts.

Document the exact endpoint paths: review mentioned /api/signals/iq720-stats and /api/ml-tournament/snapshot but actual routes are /api/iq720/outcome-stats and /api/ml/tournament/status (used in test instead).
critical_code_review_comments: twelvedata_service.py token-bucket is process-local; in a multi-worker uvicorn deployment each worker has its own 8-per-minute window so the effective rate can exceed TD free-tier limits. Consider Redis-backed bucket or single-worker enforcement.
routes/signals.py is 5274+ lines — well over the 700-line guideline. Twelve Data endpoints should be moved to a dedicated routes/twelvedata.py module.

routes/backtest.py:240-254 mutates results_data with '_id' and upserts inside a try/except — if persistence fails it's only logged; consider returning a 'persistence_warning' field so the UI can surface stale-data risk.
test_credentials: Not used (no auth-gated endpoints in scope)
seed_data_creation: None — Twelve Data is live; OTC 5s backtest uses pre-existing local_pool data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Twelve Data free-tier bucket is 8 calls / 60s and is process-local. If tests fail with 'rate_limit_local_timeout' or 'no_data' immediately after another TD-heavy run, wait ~75s before re-running. The rate-limit stress test (test_zzz_twelvedata_rate_limit_does_not_500) is intentionally suffixed 'zzz' to run last within the file so it does not deplete the bucket for earlier tests. Endpoint paths: /api/twelvedata/* (no /signals prefix); regression endpoints are /api/iq720/outcome-stats and /api/ml/tournament/status (NOT iq720-stats / ml-tournament/snapshot).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no defects found. Initial transient failures during testing were caused by the TD per-process rate bucket being depleted by a prior pytest run; resolved by adding a 75s cooldown between runs.
